newsitem.title: USA: ECRI monthly U.S. inflation gauge 107.1 in Jan.
newsitem.headline: ECRI monthly U.S. inflation gauge 107.1 in Jan.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) monthly future inflation gauge (FIG) rose to 107.1 in January from a revised 106.9 reading in the prior month, ECRI said.
The smooth annualized growth rate rose to 0.2 percent in the first month of 1997 from -0.4 in the last month of 1996.
"The gauge was pushed up in January by faster growth in industrial material prices and civilian employment," ECRI said.
